{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Naval Code''' was a set of rules and regulations that members of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] were bound to follow, regardless of their specific role.<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

The Imperial Naval Code was included within the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' given the manual's role in indoctrinating new officers of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Although [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] expressed that they needed to fight the indoctrination, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a graduate of the Naval Academy, mentioned that no one actually believed the code, not even the person who wrote the code in the first place.<ref name="IH" />

The rules in the Naval Code were:<ref name="IH" />

{{ExcerptIU|<em>''I will honor the Empire in my thoughts and actions

''I will obey my superiors

''I will never shirk from my duties

''I will maintain impeccable standards of conduct and appearance

''I will use Imperial resources responsibly

''I will complete every mission without hesitation, ambiguity, or mercy

''I will recognize that the Empire is greater than myself and be willing to die in its service

''I will call out those who do not live up to the standards of the Naval Code''
</em>|attrib=Imperial Naval Code pledges<ref name="IH" />}}
